evidence: Observation with reference to Figure 3A, B

source: In situ tracking and imaging from a side-view perspective can facilitate modeling to reconstruct the real shape of the spheroid accurately and enable researchers to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the 3D structure and growth kinetics of spheroids without disrupting their natural development.

claim: This is the first time the side-profile changes of the spheroid during a migration assay have been depicted.
